about: Allergen and dietary words as customers read them, and the general allergy notice (Kian via the PM, 2026-10-12). Read by src/lib/allergens.ts (the app) and by the research tools and drill. allergens: Health Canada's priority food allergens (crustaceans and molluscs, egg, fish, milk, mustard, peanuts, sesame, soy, sulphites, tree nuts, wheat and triticale) plus the other gluten sources (barley, oats, rye). ownerWords: the admin's suggested words (its placeholder), shown in Persian too. dietary: the only words the research drafts may carry. notice: on every venue's page; the Persian is a draft for Kian's review.

notice.en: Please tell your server about any allergies before ordering. Our dishes may contain or come into contact with common allergens.
notice.fa: لطفاً پیش از سفارش، هرگونه حساسیت غذایی را به همکاران ما اطلاع دهید. غذاهای ما ممکن است حاوی مواد حساسیت‌زای رایج باشند یا با آن‌ها در تماس قرار بگیرند.
